verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed instructions. Treasury docs are also served as clean markdown (treasury.md returns 200), and many Treasury doc pages are cited at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the Treasury section, and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
